title: Encode and Decode Strings
statement:
Design an algorithm to encode a list of strings into a single string, and decode the single string back into the original list of strings.

The encode function takes a list of strings and returns a single encoded string. The decode function takes the encoded string and returns the original list of strings. The encoding scheme must be able to handle strings that may contain special characters and preserve all information needed for exact reconstruction.
constraints: strs[i] contains any possible characters in an 8-bit range (0-255)

visibleExamples.explanation: The string 'Hello' has length 5, 'World' has length 5. Encoded as '5#Hello5#World'.
The string 'a' has length 1, empty string has length 0. Encoded as '1#a0#'.

jsonFriendlyReason: All parameters and return types are primitives (list[str] and str).
